nodes.title: How to Use & Contact
widgets_values:
# How to Use — Two-Stage Sampling v8

One MiniMax-H3 Remix workflow for image-to-video, text-to-video, first/last-frame video, digital humans, character replacement and video editing, with up to several image, audio and video references. It samples twice: the **1st pass** builds motion and composition, the **2nd pass** upscales the latent and refines detail.

## Steps
1. **Remix Loader**: pick the Remix main model, text encoder, video VAE, audio VAE and the 2nd-pass latent upscaler. Put LoRAs in the 1st / 2nd pass LoRA stacks (see the tips above for two presets).
2. **Media**: add your reference cards. Image 1, 2, 3… are `<Picture 1>`, `<Picture 2>`…; video cards are `<Video N>`, audio cards `<Audio N>`.
3. **Setup**: mode **参考生视频** (reference-to-video) is the default. Write the prompt, choose resolution, aspect ratio and length. The H3 six-section prompt format works best (`subject_definitions`, `summary`, `retention_analysis`, `detailed_description`, `overall_soundscape`, `non_diegetic_music`).
4. **Settings**: total steps / 1st pass steps / 2nd pass steps, the seed, and the audio switch: **true = keep the original audio** from your audio card, **false = audio generated by the model**.
5. Click **Run**. The 1st-pass preview and the final video (with audio) are saved to the output folder, one sub-folder per day.

## Optional groups (off by default)
Turn them on with the **Fast Groups Bypasser** switches.
- **Shot Prompts / Production Pack Loader**: run a shot md or a production pack shot by shot instead of the Setup prompt. 顺序生成 (sequential) runs every shot from the shot number on and queues the next one automatically; 手动设置 (manual) runs only the shots you list, e.g. `3`, `3-5` or `6,9`.
- **RefMods Reference Pack Loader**: needs ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod; muted by default.
- **Face Refine** (experimental): re-renders faces after the 2nd pass. Images uploaded in **Upload Character Images** take priority over the Media images; with that group off it uses the first Media image.
- **Continue & Merge Output**: continue a long video segment by segment. `latent` continues from the end of the 2nd pass, `images` from the end of Face Refine. Each segment is saved with its `.latent`, and the last one joins the full video.

## Tips
- Out of VRAM: lower the resolution in Setup, or shorten the clip.
- An `unexpected keyword argument 'attention'` error: update ComfyUI-KJNodes.
- After updating the nodes, restart ComfyUI and refresh the browser.

## Required nodes
ComfyUI-FeiHou-Easy-H3, ComfyUI-FeiHou-Toolbox, ComfyUI-KJNodes, ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite, rgthree-comfy (ComfyUI-MiniMaxH3Mod is optional). Models: see the cloud drive below or https://huggingface.co/Comfy-Org/MiniMax-H3.
